diff_stat: 3 files changed: ptPreset.ts updated focus states, MultiSelect.tsx updated to compose root classes dynamically, and MultiSelect.test.tsx added focus state unit tests.
summary: The implementation correctly introduces a focus indicator on the root wrapper of the MultiSelect component. Modifying `ptPreset.ts` to include `focus-within:border-border-secondary` and replacing the redundant focused styling with `!border-border-secondary` properly highlights the control when navigated to via Tab. Merging the preset's root styles dynamically in `MultiSelect.tsx` is an excellent approach that resolves the styling override issue. A regression unit test has been added and successfully verified. Highly clean, correct, and WCAG-compliant implementation.
